8kw4: The Bachelor of Science in Nursing (Honours) program stresses health promotion, illness prevention, and wellness, focusing on caring and compassion. Students will engage in nursing care simulation and scenarios that will prepare them for a rewarding career as a Registered Nurse. Small class sizes, state-of-the-art simulation labs, and clinical placements that begin in year one provide opportunities to explore a variety of nursing roles. Students will have access to large general nursing core labs, simulated nursing-specific care scenarios, and a simulated home environment.
